headline: Police recruitment session and an update on Support Court/Judicial Involvement for the top 64 people with highest BPD incidents.
summary: The agenda includes a session on Burlington Police Department recruitment. State's Attorney Sarah George will also give an update on Support Court and judicial involvement for the 64 people with the highest BPD incidents.
items: Update from State's Attorney Sarah George on Support Court/Judicial Involvement for the top 64 people with highest BPD incidents
